Rejected on artistic grounds, 2026-08-28. The issue asked to persist the variant seed to localStorage so the 10-25 MB payloads become deterministically cacheable. Tate: variety across visits IS the point of having recorded each park several times — Hartford Beach has 16 variants, Sica Hollow 6 — and a persisted seed freezes a walker onto one recording of each park permanently. That trades the work away for a cache hit.

What shipped in PR #77 instead: the seed stays per-session and unpersisted (unchanged behaviour), but moved into src/audio/variantSeed.ts where the session memo is documented as the correctness property it is — prefetch and the active load ask for the seed separately, and a different answer between them would download one recording on approach and play another on arrival. The strip now shows 'recording 2 of 6', which tells a walker there ARE others and invites the return visit the variety exists for.

Knock-on: rl-1u7.8 (offline/PWA) listed this as its blocker on the assumption that precaching needs a stable choice. It does not — see the note there.

Landed in PR #77. Verified on the deploy preview rather than locally: index.html serves public,max-age=0,must-revalidate and /assets/* serves public,max-age=31536000,immutable. Fonts confirmed on the real deployed build — the stylesheet link reaches media=all after load and document.fonts holds both Cormorant Garamond and Space Mono, so the non-blocking swap works in production. Tile measurement: the [0,0] opening view wastes 40 requests only when the first fix is slow; with an instant fix the ocean tiles are never fetched.

Landed in PR #78. globalSetup fetches baseURL and looks for this app before the first test; verified both directions — real dev server runs unchanged, a stand-in returning the same 403 aborts with the port, status, body and the lsof line.

Landed in PR #80. browserslist, vite build.target (safari15/ios15/chrome109/firefox115) and tsconfig target+lib ES2021 now encode the matrix; the floors are fixed rather than rolling so they cannot drift upward without an edit. Turning it on caught two live violations: Object.hasOwn in audioPaths.ts and Array.prototype.at in two tests, all ES2022 and Safari 15.4. README documents what the floor does NOT catch, measured against this build: build.target guarantees parsing, not support (a /v-flag regex is emitted as a runtime RegExp call rather than rejected), and lib:ES2021 bounds the standard library only, not DOM APIs.

Landed in PR #80. src/audio/channelCheck.ts asserts the spatial file decoded to 8 channels and falls back to the mono bed, which ResonanceAudio still positions by distance and bearing. Wired through the injected decode/merge seam in bufferLoader via onSpatialDegraded, held as sticky state (a browser that downmixes one park downmixes them all), and surfaced in the park strip. 6 unit tests on the planner plus 3 on the loader, and an e2e case that drives a stereo decode end to end.

Landed in PR #80. src/utils/capabilities.ts feature-detects Web Audio, decodeAudioData, geolocation and orientation and the welcome screen says what will not work before the walker leaves. Detection alone was not enough: iOS Safari will not answer permissions.query for geolocation and requestPermission only speaks inside a gesture, so recovery lives where the denial surfaces, with platform-specific numbered steps. Closed three dead ends in sequence: Enable Rotation did nothing when refused; the steps then named a Motion & Orientation Access switch Apple deleted in iOS 13; the button then stayed on screen offering a retry iOS answers denied without prompting. Verified on iOS 26.6.1 -- the prompt does appear, granting it makes rotation track, a denial survives a reload, and quitting Safari clears it. Table in README.

Landed on rl-0p1-test-promise-audit. onSpatialDegraded now carries the cache key, and the scoping rule lives in shouldSurfaceDegradation() in channelCheck.ts: downmixed is browser-wide and sticky, no-fallback only surfaces for the active load. Extracted as a pure function rather than left inline because the no-fallback path is unreachable through the app, so an inline guard would be untestable; 5 unit tests cover it and both inversions were verified to fail them.

Mutation pass complete; findings recorded in the issue notes. Six promises broken one at a time. Four were already caught (enter radius by e2e; prefetch cancellation, cache pinning and downmix fallback by unit). Two were not: the 15/18 m hysteresis gap and Start resuming a suspended AudioContext, both of which left all 174 tests green when broken. Both now covered by tests/geofence-hysteresis.spec.ts and tests/audio-unlock.spec.ts, each verified to fail with its mutation applied and pass without, then re-checked against the full suite. The one promise left deliberately untested is channelCheck's no-fallback branch, unreachable through the app, whose rule was extracted and unit tested instead under rl-4s6.

Landed on rl-1u7-copy-and-honest-signals. The imprecise banner is gated on prefetchParkName being set, which is true exactly when the nearest park is inside PREFETCH_DISTANCE_METERS, so a coarse cold-start fix in the walker's driveway no longer warns about a problem that is not affecting them. New e2e dwells 780 m from the walk with a 30 m fix and asserts no banner; verified to fail with the gate removed.

Landed on rl-1u7-copy-and-honest-signals. All walker-facing strings now live in src/copy.ts with the house style documented at the top; capabilities and recoverySteps keep their strings next to the rules that choose them and are covered by the same test. Rewrote the three the issue named: turn-WiFi-off now gives the reason and a symptom to recognise, no-sound-refresh now points at the silent switch, and HoaRenderer no longer renders raw exception text (behind isDebugEnabled now). copy.test.ts enforces no em dashes, no curly quotes, no web-API jargon, sentence length, and the never-tell-them-to-move-away-from-buildings rule; it caught 'no Web Audio support' on its first run.

Landed on rl-1u7-copy-and-honest-signals. useReduceVisuals holds a module-level store; effective value is storedPreference ?? prefersReducedMotion, so a stored choice wins over the system setting rather than being OR'd. Switch added to HelpModal as a sibling of Keep screen awake, with a caption naming where the current value came from since the preference has three states and a switch shows two. Unit test pins the precedence rule including the case an OR gets wrong; e2e asserts the switch reaches the ambient gradient and survives a reload, verified to fail when a layer is wired back to the bare media query.
